ns2:section.sectionText: Sapora Symposium 2021 is a Professional Development symposium featuring high profile professionals who will address contemporary issues related to entrepreneurism and applied leadership within the context of Recreation, Sport, and Tourism Industries. This is a SYNCHRONOUS online course meeting from 6pm-7pm. NOTE- The class will meet once in person on Thursday, October 28th from 6pm-8pm in Wohlers 141. You will receive an email from the instructor with specific directives. Asynchronous course option available. Please see Course Catalog for information.
